description: This is a PHP abstract class file defining AbstractVueController, which is part of a human resource management system (OrangeHRM). The class serves as a base controller for Vue.js components within the system, managing Twig templating, component handling, context attributes, and request processing.

classes.name: AbstractVueController
classes.description: An abstract controller class that provides core functionality for Vue.js component controllers, including template rendering, context management, and request handling.

methods.name: setTwig
methods.description: Sets the Twig Environment used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Specifies which Twig template to use for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns a Vue Component to this controller, throws exception if already handled.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the current Vue Component associated with this controller.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization logic for derived classes; can be overridden.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook for logic before rendering; can be overridden.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Vue component using Twig and returns the HTML string.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook for logic after rendering; can be overridden.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process the request, perform pre-render, render, post-render, and generate Response.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Provides access to the attribute bag for template context.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles bad request scenarios by setting a 'bad-request' component.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object and marks the controller as handled.

methods.name: isHandled
methods.description: Checks if the request has been handled already.

methods.name: setHandled
methods.description: Marks the controller as handled or not.
